title: Advanced Tracking
body: Advanced Tracking is a scroll-only passive available at level 20. READ an Advanced Tracking Scroll, then use the ordinary PERFORM TRACK <mob or player> command; it now follows connected routes across area borders. Advanced Tracking by itself cannot follow hidden exits. The separate level-50 Hidden Tracking passive unlocks hidden passage routes. Closed doors, missing exits and unreachable destinations remain blocked. Movement is one room per pulse, pauses during combat and costs the regular Track Chakra upkeep.
